selection_revision.name: candidate-median
selection_revision.rule: For each arm, compute the median latency of every distinct candidate across all successful cold-search trials at its selected repetitions; choose the smallest median, with canonical JSON tie-break. Do not add candidates, change top-k, or use confirmation measurements for selection.
selection_revision.previous_rule: modal per-run winner with canonical JSON tie-break
selection_revision.reason: A single-run winner majority is unnecessarily sensitive to profiling noise and does not use all per-candidate measurements when choosing the final configuration.

heldout.reason: T4096 was used for the selection-rule iteration and is now validation; T8192 has not been used for model fitting or selection-rule design.
outputs: all fwd/bwd outputs required by the original protocol
heldout.quality_rule: guided/exhaustive <= 1.02 and guided/each equal-budget control <= 1.0; identical configs are exactly equal

result_policy: Run the complete protocol once per arm/repetition, preserve every failure and outlier, and report pass or failure. Do not repeat confirmation until a preferred answer appears.
